title: Concurrency and Context Tests
summary: This module contains integration tests focused on evaluating the system's performance, stability, and resource management under concurrent workloads, as well as its ability to correctly handle and maintain conversational context across various interactions.

nodes.label: Test Multi-Model Stress
nodes.title: Test Multi-Model Stress
nodes.description: Evaluates the system's ability to manage and schedule multiple models concurrently, especially under VRAM constraints, by simulating thrashing and forced unloading scenarios.

nodes.label: Test Concurrent Chat
nodes.title: Test Concurrent Chat
nodes.description: Verifies the system's stability and performance when handling multiple simultaneous chat requests to a single language model.

nodes.label: Test Parallel Chat with History
nodes.title: Test Parallel Chat with History
nodes.description: Assesses the system's capacity to manage and maintain conversational context across multiple parallel chat sessions with a language model.

nodes.label: Test Context Exhaustion
nodes.title: Test Context Exhaustion
nodes.description: Examines how the system responds to chat requests that push or exceed the defined context window size, including error handling and response content validation.

nodes.label: Test Chat with History
nodes.title: Test Chat with History
nodes.description: Confirms the language model's ability to retain and utilize conversational history over multiple turns within a single chat session.

nodes.label: Test Long Input Context
nodes.title: Test Long Input Context
nodes.description: Tests the system's behavior when processing unusually long input prompts, checking for correct handling, truncation, or context limit errors.

nodes.label: Test Parallel Generate with History
nodes.title: Test Parallel Generate with History
nodes.description: Validates the system's capability to handle concurrent generate requests that build upon previous outputs, ensuring context is correctly passed and utilized in parallel.

nodes.label: Test Generate with History
nodes.title: Test Generate with History
nodes.description: Ensures the language model correctly uses the context from prior generations to inform subsequent generate requests within a continuous sequence.

nodes.label: Test Max Queue Behavior
nodes.title: Test Max Queue Behavior
nodes.description: Probes the server's request queuing and load management by submitting numerous concurrent embedding requests while a long generation task is active, checking for proper queue handling and error responses.

nodes.label: API Handlers
nodes.title: API Handlers Module
nodes.description: Handles incoming API requests for chat, generation, and embeddings, routing them to the appropriate backend services.

nodes.label: Model Serving & Scheduling
nodes.title: Model Serving & Scheduling Module
nodes.description: Manages the loading, scheduling, and execution of language models, including VRAM allocation and request queuing.

groups.label: Concurrency Testing
groups.title: Concurrency Testing
groups.description: Tests focused on evaluating the system's performance, stability, and resource management under concurrent workloads and high request volumes.

groups.label: Context Management Testing
groups.title: Context Management Testing
groups.description: Tests designed to verify the system's ability to correctly handle and maintain conversational or generation context across single and parallel interactions.
